answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 19460 Country: India Title: I saw a dream that Allah Subhana Tala ordered me that u should work for me. you tell the right way to the people who are going on the wrong way becaue i sent u to complete my work. When u complete the work then i call u back. He said me for Tablige. What is the meaning of this dream. Question: Asslamualaikum Mufti Sahib. I saw a dream that Allah Subhana Tala ordered me that u should work for me. you tell the right way to the people who are going on the wrong way becaue i sent u to complete my work. When u complete the work then i call u back. He said me for Tablige. What is the meaning of this dream. Please tell me. Answer ID: 19460 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 243/218/H=1431) The dream means that you lack sincerity and principle in performing tasks; you were warned to remove it. The easier way to remove is that you should try your best to invest time as per the instructions and advice of the responsible persons of Tabligh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
